description: Designate an Interface as a PUBLISHED boundary others may rely on, or back to INTERNAL plumbing its owner may change freely. An Interface is internal until someone says otherwise, because publishing is a commitment. This is the distinction a systems-engineering ICD publishes and that MOSA calls a modular system interface — and it is READ, not just stored: propagate reports which published boundaries a change crosses, so "is this part severable" is computed instead of asserted. It is NOT a claim that the boundary has held; whether it stayed stable is its drift history.

designation.description:
`internal` (the default state) or `published` — a boundary others are
entitled to rely on.

name: set_interface_designation
